legenda: Alpha Point calculation: average yearly flow at the Canadian gauge divided by the flow at The Dalles.
texto_para_tela: 87 YEARS (1938–2024) / ≈ 39% · MEASURED AT BIRCHBANK, B.C. / ≈ 15% OF THE BASIN · USACE & BPA, 2013
credito_sugerido: Alpha Point calculation: Water Survey of Canada (station 08NE049), USGS (14105700). Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Canada.
nota: Refeito do zero (conferir.py), igual ao dossiê (F023). O 39 % é do medidor de Birchbank, que inclui a água do Kootenay vinda de Montana e Idaho: nunca 'Canada's water' (K3). A USACE + BPA dá 'about 38 percent of the average annual volume' para as águas canadenses em The Dalles. Protagonista: Birchbank (--destaque); The Dalles, --contraparte.
conversoes: Birchbank: média de cada ano = média das 12 médias mensais (m³/s) ÷ 0.028316846592 = cfs
a média das 87 razões anuais dá 39.9 % (de 30.2 a 52.0 %)

grafias_do_espelho: ≈ 39% OF THE WATER PASSING THE DALLES, MEASURED AT BIRCHBANK · ALPHA POINT CALCULATION
Alpha Point calculation: Water Survey of Canada (station 08NE049), USGS (14105700)
Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Canada.
texto_aprovado: We lined the two records up, year against year, for the 87 years they share. On average, the river at the Canadian gauge is already carrying about 39 percent of the water that will pass The Dalles. That's our own calculation, from the two governments' data. About 15 percent of the land, and at the Canadian gauge, about 39 percent of the water.
